nodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Core perk damage definition module exposing the PerkDmgDef/PerkDmgCtx/HpGate interfaces, a large PERK_DMG_DEFS array (140+ perk entries) describing base damage, scaling, hits, proc coefficients, and secondary effects, plus HP-gate helpers and the findPerkDmgDef lookup. Powers the damage calculator's per-perk behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Data-driven TypeScript module: each PerkDmgDef carries function fields (getBaseDamage, getHits, getDmgTypes, getScalings) for dynamic per-build scaling; definitions are indexed at module load into a Map keyed by perkName.

nodes.name: gateThreshold
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective HP-gate threshold for a perk, honoring the alwaysActiveAtPerkAmount override and falling back to a dynamic getThreshold callback or the static hpThreshold.

nodes.name: isHpGateActive
nodes.summary: Determines whether a perk's HP gate is currently active by comparing the HP fill percentage against the resolved gate threshold.

nodes.name: calcSpringblastBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes Springblast base damage from perk amount using the base/per-stack hit values and a per-stack multiplier.

nodes.name: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes Bomber Charge base damage scaled by perk amount and a capped missing-health percentage, rounded to three decimals.

nodes.name: findPerkDmgDef
nodes.summary: Looks up the PerkDmgDef entries for a perk name in the module-level Map, optionally filtering by label, and returns the matching def or undefined.

nodes.name: DmgTotalTooltip.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte 5 tooltip component that renders a per-hit damage breakdown from a ComputedHit, grouping damage types into labeled, color-coded totals with badges, percentages, and an animated SVG donut chart. Applies crit, heal/curse-rip filtering, once-per-group and once-per-RMB counting, and activation divisors.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props, $derived, $state) with an SVG donut pie animated via requestAnimationFrame after mount.

nodes.name: buildGroups
nodes.summary: Aggregates a ComputedHit's damage types into labeled groups, computing per-type totals while skipping heals and curse-rips and applying crit, once-per-group, once-per-RMB, and sub-hit counting rules.

nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Central constants module holding 160+ buff/debuff potency and duration values sourced from game BuffData.ts, covering potions, rune-granted buffs, weapon-art debuffs, and perk-buff factory coefficients used by the damage calculator.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports only flat scalar constants (no functions), named in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE and grouped by game source with section comments.
